name: Marigold Magic – Decorate the School!
competency: Understanding addition as joining two discrete groups (Count -> Add More -> Count Again)
ncertStandard: Grade 1 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 4 (Addition - How Many Altogether?)
overview: An Indian Independence Day school decoration adventure where children count traditional orange marigold garland flowers, attach new sunny yellow flowers, and discover the combined total through one-to-one counting and addition.
learningOutcomes: Count individual discrete objects with accurate 1-to-1 correspondence
Understand addition conceptually as combining an existing set with a newly added set
Practice counting-on from an existing quantity to reach the sum
Connect visual manipulatives (orange and yellow marigold flowers) with addition equations (A + B = Total)
Recognize mathematical terminology: 'How many in this laddi?', 'Add more', and 'How many altogether?'

levels.name: Level 1: Little Decorator
levels.description: Count 1 to 5 original orange flowers, add 1 or 2 yellow flowers (totals up to 7)

levels.name: Level 2: Flower Helper
levels.description: Count 3 to 7 orange flowers, add 1 to 4 yellow flowers with addition equations (totals up to 10)

levels.name: Level 3: Decoration Champion
levels.description: Original flowers 5 to 10, add 2 to 5 yellow flowers (totals up to 15)

levels.name: Level 4: Independence Day Expert
levels.description: Challenging combinations up to 20 flowers for the grand celebration garland
